catalogue: Haritech Exclusive Business — Proposed Master Price Register

activation.note: No service in this file is approved. Nothing here is imported by the application. Activation requires explicit owner approval and a separate implementation step.

rules: Proposed prices are reproduced exactly from the owner register.
A price may not be published while effective_date is null.
Third-party costs (government, freight, duty, tax, materials) must be itemised separately from Haritech service fees.
Included services must never be charged again as add-ons.
No default discount, tax, exchange rate or freight rate is approved in this file.
Historical quotations must not be recalculated when this register is activated.
